text:
Buis-les-Baronnies (French pronunciation:; Vivaro-Alpine Occitan: Lo Bois dei Baroniás) is a commune in the Drôme department in the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region in Southeastern France.

Buis-les-Baronnies is located on the right bank of the river Ouvèze (Buis-les-Baronnies as a town has limits on the other bank).
